[{"insert":"Push Up + Internal Dumbbell Lateral Raise

Two pressing movements that target the chest and shoulder from different angles back to back. The push up accumulates horizontal pressing volume through a full range of motion. The internal dumbbell lateral raise that follows shifts the load onto the front and medial delts through a controlled arc. TThe 30X0 tempo on the raise means three seconds down.  Control the lowering rather than dropping the arms..  Do not rush it. Push close to failure on each set.
"}]
